tasks.title: Route System Health Dashboard red lights into the Telegram CoS channel
tasks.step:
The gap Tim named 2026-08-06: scheduled Cowork tasks that silently stop running have no push path to his phone. The CoS failure-notifier only covers n8n workflows failing. medic-detect covers a narrow on-host slice (export integrity, sweep output presence, Task Scheduler results, cos-daily-brief).

The fix is small because the logic already exists. daily-execution-sweep (TSK-542) already computes the heartbeat pass and red lights in Section 1 of the System Health Dashboard. It just does not push them anywhere. Wire its red lights into the same localhost n8n webhook the Medic Layer already uses (MEDIC: prefix), or a parallel one.

Design constraints, learned from the 8/6 alert:
- One alert per root cause, not one per symptom.
- Only push state changes (green to red), not standing red items, or the daily push becomes noise.
- Recursion floor: the sweep runs on the infrastructure it monitors, so it cannot report its own death. Healthchecks.io (live since 8/2) is the off-box backstop for that case and should stay the outer layer.

Prerequisite: TSK for medic check-window fixes should land first, or this amplifies false positives instead of real ones.
